peaa_reforged.config.emc_mapper.tooltip: Gives the Ultimate AEGU an EMC value, which ProjectE cannot derive because its recipe requires a fully charged Klein Star Omega. Off by default, matching the original mod. The value ignores the star's stored EMC, so it is lower than the true crafting cost; use /projecte setemc to override it.
